summary: Mangoceuticals filed an 8-K reporting that the sole holder of all 50 outstanding Series B Convertible Preferred shares, by written consent dated November 2, 2026, approved an amendment to the Series B certificate of designations and the terms of a new 8% Series D Convertible Cumulative Preferred Stock. The board had previously approved the amendment. The consent authorizes sale of up to 1,000,000 Series D shares at $10.00 per share under a Regulation A offering, subordinating Series B dividend and liquidation rights; neither instrument has been filed with Texas or become effective, and the company may not proceed. Watch for a follow-on 8-K confirming effectiveness and offering launch.
